definitions.explanation: A clock that can be set to make a sound at a specific time, typically used to wake someone up.

examples.japanese: {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}を{六時|ろくじ}にセットした。
examples.english: I set the alarm clock for 6 o'clock.

examples.japanese: {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}が{鳴|な}っても{起|お}きられなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't wake up even when the alarm clock went off.

examples.japanese: {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}を{止|と}める。
examples.english: To turn off the alarm clock.

notes:
COMPOUND: {目覚|めざ}まし (awakening, alarm) + {時計|とけい} (clock)

Note: The reading of {時計|とけい} changes to どけい through rendaku.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}をセットする/かける (set the alarm)
- {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}を{止|と}める (turn off the alarm)
- {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}が{鳴|な}る (alarm goes off)

ALTERNATIVE: Often shortened to アラーム (alarm) in modern usage, especially when referring to smartphone alarms.

RELATED:
- {時計|とけい} (clock, watch)
- アラーム (alarm)
- {起|お}きる (to wake up)
